text:
Rina: quick flag  newmodel-qbringup shows ~5% drop on long-table prompts vs baseline. Looks tokenization-heavy.

Otto: drop the eval command?

Rina: `rwt eval --model newmodel-qbringup --dataset promptbank/tables-holdout --metrics exact_match --tokenizer token-aligner-v1`

Leah: tagging curation + label ops. I'll grab top-50 failing ids and spawn a rapid workspace.

labeler-bot: 3 labelers on duty, rapid queue 120. ETA ~8h for 50 items.

Otto: ran a quick variant with `--tokenizer token-aligner-v0` and `--preserve-newlines` — gap narrows a lot.

Rina: sounds like tokenizer parity issue + some duplicates. Can we run a fuzzy dedupe on top-50 and mark orphans for micro-golden?

Leah: doing dedupe now `fuzzyhash --thresh 0.76` and creating workspace "mg-tokenfix-2026" for flagged anchors.

Otto: will hold canary until micro-gold/rescore and labeler verdicts. Preparing a tiny CI test to assert tokenizer parity for qbringup.

Rina: plan: block rollout, land tokenizer parity test, run micro-golden refresh with flagged anchors, re-eval. Thanks team.
